title: Cosmic graveyard of zombie planets offers a grisly warning about our own solar system's fate
caption:
Astronomers have spotted two 'zombie' planets surviving the death of their host star 1,600 light-years away. These rocky remnants offer a haunting preview of what might happen to our own solar system in the distant future.

Source: Space - Cosmic graveyard of zombie planets offers a grisly warning about our own solar system's fate
